tasks.question_zh: 2001年2月门店净销售额的同比增长率是多少？

      SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) AS amt FROM msb_store_sales

    new_ids AS (SELECT i_item_id FROM first_sale WHERE year(first_d) = 2002)
    SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN n.i_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN ss.ss_net_paid ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_net_paid), 0)
    FROM msb_store_sales ss LEFT JOIN new_ids n ON n.i_item_id = ss.i_item_id
    WHERE ss.d_year = 2002 AND ss.i_category = 'Home'

WITH new_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT i_item_id FROM item
      WHERE i_rec_start_date IS NOT NULL AND year(i_rec_start_date) = 2002)
    SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN n.i_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN ss.ss_net_paid ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_net_paid), 0)
    FROM msb_store_sales ss LEFT JOIN new_ids n ON n.i_item_id = ss.i_item_id
    WHERE ss.d_year = 2002 AND ss.i_category = 'Home'
